stages.1: Initial - some automation, starting to integrate
stages.2: Advanced - automated controls, centralized visibility, policy-based
stages.3: Optimal - fully automated, dynamic, continuous enforcement

pillars.notes: MFA broadly deployed; moving toward phishing-resistant + continuous auth. Ties to Lab 6 IAM findings.
EDR deployed but device compliance not enforced as an access condition.
Partial segmentation (Lab 5); macro-segmentation only, no per-session policy.
Some app-level authz; workloads not continuously authorized.
Classification policy exists (Lab 12) but tagging/DLP not automated; encryption inconsistent.
SIEM in place (Lab 2); cloud/OT telemetry gaps remain.
Limited SOAR; response largely manual (see Lab 4 containment timing).
Policy suite and risk governance maturing (Labs 7, 8, 12); not yet dynamic/policy-as-code.
